name: Tobacco Use
overview: Scripture teaches that defilement comes not from external habits but from the thoughts and actions that proceed from the heart (Mark 7:15). Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, and to resist conformity to worldly practices by renewing their minds (Romans 12:1-2). The works of the flesh, which include uncleanness and behaviors that displease God, lead to spiritual consequences and exclusion from His kingdom (Galatians 5:19, 21). Therefore, Christians must be mindful that their choices, including tobacco use, reflect their commitment to God's will and that they will reap according to what they sow (Galatians 6:7).
